fieldValues.title: Derive
fieldValues.needs: each record that comes from a vignette (problem, remedy, domain, decision, exercise) is a suggestion `derived-from` it, or an existing record gets an `evidences` link from it; look before you create
fieldValues.theory: Records follow the narrative (decision 77e04b19, proposed). Affirming them is not a step of this flow: it is its own layer (*The affirmation layer*), and work never waits on it.
gaps: Nothing lists the vignettes that have no derived or linked record yet (clerk#199).
